page.overview:
Who is Archlord Kristya?

Archlord Kristya is a character version of the card, "Archlord Kristya". It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2010: Reverse of Arcadia and Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus as a Single Duel opponent.

In Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2010: Reverse of Arcadia, you can unlock this opponent by defeating Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest 3 times in a duel.

In Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus, you can unlock this opponent by defeating Guardian Eatos 3 times in a duel.

In Reverse of Arcadia, Archlord Kristya uses a Deck titled, "No Special Summon".
